title: Finishing Self-Massage
summary: Several light passes over the chosen area gradually reduce intensity.
goal: Finish a short self-massage session calmly.
startingPosition: Choose an area you have already worked on.
direction: Over the treated area with decreasing pressure.
warning: Stop self-massage with pain, numbness, weakness, dizziness, radiating sensations, or other unusual symptoms.
